selection_rule.quality_floor: both hit@1 and hit@3 no more than 0.05 below flat on dev, with at least 20% of branches pruned on average
selection_rule.if_floor_met: minimize record ratio, then maximize hit@3 and hit@1

negative_audit.reason: Negative correctness is not scored without independently exhaustive absence GT.

failures.query: Find the glass-block wall on the right side
Find an area suitable for moving between street levels
Find the rocky island surrounded by water

decision.selected_reason: lowest checked-record cost among qualifying points

cost_accounting.serialized_context: view records retained for leaf ranking plus all root child summaries needed for branch scoring
cost_accounting.proxy_view_comparisons: cached lexical leaf proxies evaluated for every scene view; reported separately and never called sublinear
cost_accounting.construction_cost: excluded from per-query retrieval and reported separately in existing construction artifacts
